cases.input: Structure an exclusive p-tau assay technology license including patents, know-how, improvements, sublicensing and milestones.
requiredBehaviors: build a rights and chain-of-title map before licensing conclusions
separate patent technical/FTO work from legal license structure
analyze exclusivity field territory sublicensing improvements economics termination and competition overlay
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a patent application as proof of complete ownership
give a final FTO legal opinion from the license review

cases.input: A German employee invented part of the technology, ownership records are incomplete and the license includes a broad no-challenge and grant-back clause.
requiredBehaviors: route employee invention ownership through the ArbnErfG gate
route restrictive IP clauses to competition-antitrust-law-specialist
forbiddenBehaviors: assume employer ownership from payroll status alone
assume IP rights exempt restraints from competition law

cases.input: Draft a worldwide exclusive license for everything the company owns without identifying assets, existing licenses or ownership evidence.
requiredBehaviors: block a legally reliable license conclusion until assets scope and rights chain are identified
forbiddenBehaviors: license undefined rights as if ownership were proven
